item.title: Comment on Sarah Cockbill (1947–2026) by Michael Beaman
item.description: Sarah was also a valued member of the Retired Pharmacists Group and represented Wales on our national steering committee. She will be greatly missed.

item.title: Comment on Sarah Cockbill (1947–2026) by David Reissner
item.description: I am sorry to learn of Sarah's passing. I knew her as a knowledgeable contributor to the 11th and 12th editions of Dale & Appelbe's Pharmacy and Medicines Law.

item.title: Comment on Special report: pharmacists’ views on assisted dying by Gregory Lawton

item.title: Comment on Sarah Cockbill (1947–2026) by Robert Morris
item.description: Sarah was a great supporter of veterinary pharmacy and was ever-present at our meetings for many years and until very recently. She also served as a pharmacist member of the Veterinary Products Committee (VPC) advising DEFRA on medicinal products and feed additives.

item.title: Comment on Special report: pharmacists’ views on assisted dying by Siobhan Chan
item.description: In reply to <a href="https://pharmaceutical-journal.com/article/feature/special-report-pharmacists-views-on-assisted-dying#comment-187854">Gregory Lawton</a>. Thank you for flagging this, Gregory. We've investigated this, and there was an error in Figure 5 which was caused by our data visualisation platform. We've now corrected the figure. The correct statistic is that 38% of respondents agreed with the bill proposed in England and Wales.

item.title: Comment on Why Ramadan is a clinical opportunity for pharmacy by Jonathan Underhill
item.description: Very useful article. Timing is everything, as they say! If the PJ will endulge with a shameless plug, this article coincides with an episode of the Talking Meds podcast from PrescQIPP on this very topic! I have an extremely engaging conversation with Dr Salman Waqar, one of the authors of the guidance referenced in this article. If interested you can access it for free here: https://www.buzzsprout.com/2374964/episodes/18794692-39-medicines-optimisation-during-periods-of-fasting-with-dr-salman-wa
